purpose: Fix the SPEED-2 PR contract so an experiment scope is not forced to authorize unrelated controller/canary files that the branch does not modify; changed-path authority remains enforced by p7-autopilot-guard.
requiredBehavior: retain all owner provenance exact-main deployed-SHA pinned-SSH privacy and production fail-closed controls
require every SPEED-2 branch scope to authorize its own scope file
do not require a branch to authorize controller or canary files unless they are actually in that branch's changed paths
leave changed-path enforcement to the existing p7-autopilot-guard
forbiddenCapabilities: weaken owner provenance exact-main deployed-SHA pinned-SSH privacy or production fail-closed controls
runtime model application prompt database service or production mutation
arbitrary shell sudo root SSH or unrelated product scope
